decisions.reason: The firm has invested heavily in this product and committed to it visibly, with a dedicated page and government references to the UK Home Office and over 30 APIS schemes, so it remains central to its aviation security direction.
The module fits the firm's established training business and certified trainers and is cheap to maintain, though its low visibility makes it the easiest candidate to drop.
Behaviour analysis is core to the firm's specialist detection identity and its announced innovation direction, so management persists with it and treats any weak visible results as temporary.
